text: Rigged up the Pride 1502 rig on slot 7 EB 161 A-13.  TIH w/ 13-1/2" directional BHA, washed out the drive pipe with 8.6 ppg seawater and surveyed.  Directionally drilled w/ 13-1/2" BHA to 2,890' MD.  Ran and cemented 11-3/4" casing.  Installed 11-3/4" wellhead.  NU and tested 13-5/8" 10M BOPE, and Weatherford?s RCH.  TIH w/ 9-7/8? directional BHA.  Displace seawater to 10.8 ppg SBM and drilled out shoe track and 10? of new formation and ran LOT to 11.9 ppg.  Slide drilled to 5,964' MD.  Ran 7-3/4" casing tagging up at 5,219? MD.  Unable to get deeper.  Cemented in place in 2 stages with the ICP/stage collar and set on back-ups slips in the wellhead at the surface.  P/U 6-1/2? x 7-1/2" BHA and drilled out cement and 10? new formation and ran LOT to 13.6 ppg which was not sufficient to get to TD.  Performed first EZ Squeeze at the 7-3/4? casing shoe.  Drilled to 6,162? MD and had losses that prevented further drilling.  Performed second EZ Squeeze across entire open hole section and again had losses that prevented drilling ahead.  Set two expandable liners, the second of which was successfully set at 6,162? MD.  Directionally drilled with 5-1/2? x 6-1/2? BHA to TD of 7,230' MD.  Ran and cemented 5" liner due to the smaller hole restriction.  Circulated 12.3 ppg SBM in the hole.  ND BOPE and installed dry hole tree and tested to 1,000 psi.  Skidded rig to slot 6 for A-1ST.
